units.name: Department of Management, Economics and Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Official university department page gives exact English title. The university PhD detail lists its current Management Engineering doctorate in Department Ingegneria Gestionale (DIG); department site connects the English department title to that doctorate.

decisions.reason: Frozen faculty record names a doctorate institution, not a department. Actual DIG department is independently verified; individual doctorate claim remains discovery only.
